property_summary: For any caller address X and newOwner address Y, when X == current owner the reference contract allows transferOwnership(Y) (so owner becomes Y); the mutant inverts the guard and disallows owner's calls, so there exist inputs (X equal to owner and Y arbitrary) where the mutant fails this property.
change_summary: Replace the require condition to check msg.sender != owner, effectively inverting the onlyOwner guard so transferOwnership can only be called by non-owners.
